app.name: Openbeehive
app.offline_banner: Offline: changes are saved and synced later.

qr.offline_text: This hive has not been downloaded to this device yet. Connect to the internet and it opens as soon as your data has synced.
qr.missing_title: This hive is not in your data
qr.missing_text: Everything is synced, but this hive is not part of the workspace you are in. It may belong to another workspace (switch in Settings), have been deleted, or be someone else's hive.
qr.signed_out_title: Sign in to open this hive
qr.signed_out_text: This browser is not signed in to Openbeehive, so it has none of your hives yet. Sign in and the hive opens once your data has synced.
qr.unreachable_text: The hive is not on this device and the server did not answer, so it could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
qr.installed_hint: Using the installed app? The phone's camera opens labels in the browser, which keeps its own separate data. Open Openbeehive from your home screen and use Scan there.

scan.aim: Aim at the hive's QR code
scan.title: Scan a hive label
scan.not_hive: That is not an Openbeehive hive label.
scan.hard_to_read: Can't read it? Move closer, hold steady and avoid glare — or type the code printed under the QR code.
scan.denied_text: Allow camera access for Openbeehive in your browser or system settings, then try again.
scan.nocamera_text: This device has no camera the app can use. Type the code printed under the QR code instead.
scan.failed_title: The camera could not be started
scan.failed_text: Another app may be using it. Close that app and try again.
scan.code_help: Label unreadable? Type the six characters printed under the QR code.
scan.code_unknown: No hive with this code on this device.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.help: Follow your device's setting or choose light or dark. Your choice is saved on this device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_help: Choose the language for the app. Your choice is saved with your account and applies on all your devices.

units.title: Units
units.help: Choose how weights and temperatures are shown and entered. Your choice is saved with your account and applies on all your devices.
units.metric_note: Records are always stored in kilograms and degrees Celsius, and exports stay metric. The units change only what you see and type.

account.workspace_lost: You are no longer a member of the workspace you were working in. You are now in another of your workspaces.
account.err_signed_out: You are signed out. Please sign in again.
account.err_password_short: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
account.err_password_mismatch: The two entries of the new password differ.
account.err_no_password: This account has no password yet. To set one, sign out and use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
account.err_password_managed: The password of the instance administrator is set in the server configuration (BEEHIVE_ADMIN_PASSWORD) and cannot be changed here.
account.err_admin_only: Only the instance administrator can do this.
account.err_account_not_found: No account has this email address.
account.err_demo: The demo account is shared by all visitors and cannot be changed.
account.err_sole_owner: You are still the only admin of a workspace that has other members. Make someone else an admin or delete the workspace first.
account.err_reauth_required: Confirming with your passkey did not work. Please try again.
account.logout_help: You stay signed in on your other devices.
account.logout_unsent_kept: {n, plural, one {# change has not been uploaded yet. It stays on this device and is uploaded when you sign in here again.} other {# changes have not been uploaded yet. They stay on this device and are uploaded when you sign in here again.}}
account.logout_unsent_lost: {n, plural, one {# change has not been uploaded yet and will be lost.} other {# changes have not been uploaded yet and will be lost.}} Go online and wait for the sync before you remove the data.
account.logout_remove_data: Also remove data from this device
account.logout_remove_data_help: For shared devices: deletes this workspace’s records and downloaded photos from this browser. Everything that was synced stays in your account.
account.logout_remove_failed: The data could not be removed from this device, so you are still signed in. Close other tabs of Openbeehive and try again.
account.logout_all_help: Signs you out on every other device, for example after losing a phone. You stay signed in here.
account.logout_all: Sign out on all other devices
account.logout_all_confirm: Sign out on all your other devices? API keys keep working.
account.logout_all_done: Done. Only this device is still signed in.
account.password_help: Changing the password signs you out on all other devices.
account.password_changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
account.admin_reset_help: As instance administrator you can create a link with which a user chooses a new password. Use it when this server sends no email or the mail does not arrive. Give the link only to the account’s owner: whoever opens it sets the password.
account.admin_reset_done: Reset link for {email}, valid until {time} and usable once:
account.delete_intro: Deleting your account cannot be undone. This is what happens:
account.delete_personal: Deleted: your sign-in details (email address, name, password, passkeys, provider login), your API keys and your personal tasks.
account.delete_workspaces: Deleted with all apiaries, hives, records and photos, because you are the only member: {names}.
account.delete_leaves: Kept for the other members: the records you wrote in {names}. They stay there, marked as written by a deleted user.
account.delete_blocked: Not possible yet: you are the only admin of a workspace that has other members. Make someone else an admin there (under Members) or delete the workspace first.
account.delete_blocked_item: “{name}”: {n, plural, one {# other member} other {# other members}}
account.delete_protected_admin: This is the instance administrator account from the server configuration (BEEHIVE_ADMIN_EMAIL). It cannot be deleted in the app.
account.delete_passkey: You will be asked to confirm with one of your passkeys.
account.delete_login: This account signs in without a password. To confirm, your sign-in must be less than 5 minutes old; if it is older, you will be asked to sign in again.
account.delete_login_required: Your sign-in is more than 5 minutes old. Sign in again; you will come back here and can then delete your account.

auth.name: Name
auth.have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.verify_sent: We've sent you a link to confirm your email. Open it to finish signing up.
auth.verified_ok: Email verified — you can sign in now.
auth.err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.invite_only_banner: This instance is invite-only. Registration is disabled — sign in with an existing account or use your invite link.
auth.invited_banner: You've been invited. Create your account below — or sign in if you already have one.
auth.demo_hint: No account needed: explore with sample data. It resets every hour.
auth.err_unverified: Please confirm your email address first. Check your inbox for the link.
auth.err_invite_only: This instance is invite-only. Ask for an invite to create an account.
auth.err_email_taken: An account with this email address already exists.
auth.err_invalid_input: Enter a valid email address and a password of at least 8 characters.
auth.err_password_too_long: This password is too long. Use 72 characters at most.
auth.err_email_reserved: This email address cannot be used.
auth.err_invite_mismatch: This invite was issued for a different email address.
auth.err_invite_invalid: This invite is invalid or has expired.
auth.err_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.err_demo_unavailable: The demo is not available right now.
auth.err_passkey_failed: Signing in with the passkey did not work. Try again or use another way to sign in.
auth.err_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.forgot_help: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgot_sent: If an account exists for this address, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It is valid for one hour. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
auth.forgot_needs_admin: This server does not send email. Ask its administrator for a reset link: they can create one for your account in Settings.
auth.forgot_off: This server has no password sign-in, so there is no password to reset. Sign in the way you did before.
auth.reset_help: At least 8 characters. Afterwards you are signed out on all devices and sign in with the new password.
auth.reset_done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth.reset_invalid: This reset link is not valid any more: it was already used or is older than one hour. Ask for a new one.
auth.err_verification_invalid: This confirmation link is not valid or was already used. If your address is confirmed, just sign in.
auth.err_provider_expired: The sign-in took too long or was interrupted. Please start again.
auth.err_provider_failed: The sign-in provider did not confirm your identity. Please try again.
auth.err_provider_no_email: The sign-in provider did not share an email address. Allow access to your email address and try again.
auth.err_account_exists: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in the way you did before, for example with your email and password.
auth.reauth_notice: Sign in again to confirm. You will then return to where you were.

demo.banner: You're exploring the Openbeehive demo — data resets every hour.

tenant.title: Workspaces
tenant.help: A workspace holds apiaries, hives and records that its members share. Switch between yours, or create another one, for example for a club.
tenant.invite_sent: Invite link created. Share it with them:
tenant.delete_help: Deletes the workspace “{name}” with all its apiaries, hives, records and photos — for every member, not only for you. This cannot be undone.
tenant.invite_help: The invite is tied to this email address and valid for 7 days. If this server sends email, the link is mailed; you can always copy it here.
tenant.invite_revoke_confirm: Revoke the invite for {email}? The link stops working.

members.title: Members
members.help_owner: Everyone here sees and edits all records of this workspace. Admins also manage members, invites and API keys.
members.help_member: Everyone here sees and edits all records of this workspace.
members.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from this workspace? They lose access immediately, including their API keys. The records they wrote stay.
members.leave_confirm: Leave the workspace “{name}”? You lose access to its records immediately. To come back you need a new invite.
members.err_last_owner: A workspace needs at least one admin. Make another member an admin first, or delete the workspace.
members.err_owner_only: Only an admin of this workspace can do this.
members.err_not_found: This person is no longer a member of the workspace.

data.title: Data & backup
data.export_help: Download the records of the active workspace. Weights and temperatures are always exported in kg and °C, whatever units you display.
data.import_help: Import an Openbeehive backup (JSON, or ZIP with photos), a BeeXML file, or a CSV of visits from another beekeeping app into the active workspace. You see a preview before anything is written.
data.json_help: Every apiary, hive, queen, visit, treatment, harvest, task and timeline entry of this workspace as this device holds it, including your personal tasks and changes not uploaded yet. It can be imported again, here or on another instance. Without photos it is one JSON file; with photos it is a ZIP that also holds the full-size images.
data.include_photos_help: Makes a ZIP. Images that are not on this device are fetched from the server; when that is not possible, the export says how many are missing.
data.other_help: Spreadsheet (XLSX) and CSV: one table per kind of record, for other programs. BeeXML: apiaries, hives, queens and visits. Report: a printable overview. These are for reading elsewhere; to restore your data, use the full backup.
data.not_synced: This device has not finished loading the workspace from the server yet. Export and import are possible once the first sync is complete.
data.pending_note: {n} changes made on this device have not been uploaded yet. They are included in the export.
data.failed_note: {n} changes were refused by the server (see Sync problems). They are in the export, but not on the server.
data.photos_missing: Export downloaded, but {n} photos are missing: their images are not on this device and cannot be fetched from the server right now (offline, or not uploaded yet). Their thumbnails are included.
data.server_help: The complete copy of this workspace that the server holds, in the same format as the full backup. It includes your own personal tasks but not those of other members. Changes that a device has not uploaded yet are not in it. Scripts can fetch it with an API key from /export (/export?photos=1 for the ZIP). A few downloads per hour are allowed.
data.server_failed: The server export failed. Try again later.
data.server_rate_limited: Too many server exports in the last hour. Try again later.
data.server_offline: The server cannot be reached. Connect to the internet and try again.
data.server_forbidden: This account may not download the server copy.
data.import_default: By default an import only adds: records that already exist in this workspace, deleted ones too, are skipped and never changed. A file from another workspace gets new ids, so it never touches existing records. A CSV uses the apiaries and hives that have the same name and skips visits that are already recorded. You can undo the last import.
data.preview_foreign: This file comes from another workspace. Its records get new ids; existing records are not changed.
data.photos_no_image: {n} photos in the file have no image; only their thumbnails are imported.
data.overwrite_help: Writes the values of the file where they differ. Only fields the file contains are written; changes made to them since the export are lost. Deleted records stay deleted.
data.nothing_to_do: Nothing to import: everything in the file is already here.
data.undone_kept: Import undone: {n} records deleted. {kept} were kept because records were added to them since.

apikeys.help: Keys let scripts and devices, such as a hive scale, use the API as you in this workspace. Create one per device and remove it when the device is retired.

apikeys.delete_theirs_confirm: Remove this member's key? Their scripts using it stop working immediately.

apikeys.usage_help: Every call is a POST with a JSON body and the key in the Authorization header. This one lists your hives:
